scope: HNK v1.1 spoken cardinal infrastructure for 0-9

decision_requested.statement: Approve TEN_PRIMITIVE_DIGIT_NUMERALS as the authoring strategy for spoken HNK values 0 through 9, with each future form entering as a new CANDIDATE primitive and no historical-recovery claim.

generation_constraints: Meaning 0-9 is fixed before form selection.
Use safe HNK40 transliteration units only unless a separately governed G-ID mapping is used.
Prefer short pronounceable forms but reject exact and near-confusion collisions.
Do not select forms by numerology, glyph appearance or assumed mystical correspondence.
Do not make numeral candidates FROZEN on first entry.
Do not decide 10-99 composition as a side effect of generating 0-9.

progress_effect_if_approved_strategy_onl.reason: Strategy approval permits candidate generation; OPI 3 remains HOLD until a sufficient spoken age answer system exists.
